mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_draft (user_id, project_id, prompt, priority, plugin_ids, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{projectId}, #{prompt}, #{priority}, CAST(#{pluginIds} AS JSON), #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE project_id = VALUES(project_id), prompt = VALUES(prompt), priority = VALUES(priority), plugin_ids = VALUES(plugin_ids), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
